title: eval-harness: per-prompt regression CI hooks + metrics export
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We need finer-grained CI checks for prompt-set regressions and a lightweight metrics export so failures can be triaged by prompt and evaluation metric. This PR adds per-prompt CI hooks that run a subset of eval-harness tests for changed prompt files, publishes normalized metric slices to a Prometheus-compatible pushgateway during CI, and wires the gating logic into the existing GitHub Checks integration.

Summary of changes: added a new eval-harness sync script (scripts/ci/run_per_prompt_evals.py) that identifies changed prompt sets and runs targeted evals; introduced a small metrics exporter (tools/ci_metrics/exporter.py) which emits JSON and pushes to a pushgateway endpoint when running in CI; extended .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml to include a per-prompt job that runs in parallel with full evals; added gating logic to the existing check runner (tools/checks/gate.py) to fail only when the metric delta exceeds configured thresholds for a prompt slice.

Checklist:
- [x] add per-prompt detection logic and targeted runner
- [x] bulk and incremental metrics exporter (push + local JSON)
- [x] CI workflow integration and required secrets handling
- [x] unit tests for detection logic and gating thresholds
- [x] docs: brief runbook + troubleshooting notes in docs/eval-harness/ci-hooks.md

Commits (high level):
- feat(ci): add per-prompt eval runner and basic gating hooks
- feat(ci): metrics exporter and pushgateway integration
- test: add unit tests for prompt-diff detection and gating thresholds
- ci: wire per-prompt job into eval CI workflow and add secrets usage guard
- docs: add runbook and examples for local runs

Files changed (high level):
- scripts/ci/run_per_prompt_evals.py (new) - logic to diff changed prompts and run subset of evals
- tools/ci_metrics/exporter.py (new) - emits per-prompt metrics and pushes to pushgateway
- tools/checks/gate.py (modified) - add per-prompt slicing and threshold checks
- .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml (modified) - add per-prompt job and conditionals to skip when not applicable
- tests/test_per_prompt_detection.py (new) - unit tests for detection logic
- docs/eval-harness/ci-hooks.md (new) - usage and troubleshooting

CI results: initial run showed a flaky test in tests/test_per_prompt_detection.py (timeout on CI container). I re-ran the job and all checks passed. The per-prompt job includes a conditional to skip if no prompt files were changed (reduces noise). The exported metrics are available as JSON artifacts and are pushed to the configured pushgateway for downstream dashboards.

Merge: Squash-merged to main after approval and green CI.

Notes for reviewers: The gating thresholds default to conservative values (0.05 relative delta on primary metric per prompt) and can be tuned via environment variables. I included a short runbook with examples for local debugging. If teams want, we can add a Slack notifier for pushed metrics in a follow-up PR.
